properties.description: Incremental (delta) ingestion pipeline from Azure SQL to ADLS Gen2. Reads all active Incremental Ingress jobs for the given trigger from EDP_Metadata.MasterRef. Watermark column and last high-water mark value are resolved from metadata at runtime. Watermark is only advanced on confirmed successful copy with at least one row transferred. Parallel processing via ForEach (batchCount=5).

activities.name: Lookup_Metadata
activities.description: Fetches all active Incremental Ingress jobs for the given TriggerName from EDP_Metadata.MasterRef. Returns Watermark_Column and Watermark_Value alongside all connection and path parameters.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT * FROM EDP_Metadata.MasterRef WHERE Trigger_Name = ''', pipeline().parameters.TriggerName, ''' AND IsActive = ''Active'' AND Load_Type = ''Incremental'' AND ActivityType = ''Ingress''')

activities.name: ForEach_Jobs
activities.description: Iterates over all active incremental jobs returned by the metadata lookup and processes them in parallel (batchCount=5). Each iteration validates its watermark before copying.

activities.name: Switch_OutputFormat
activities.description: Routes each job to the correct Copy activity based on SwitchCaseRef.

activities.name: Validate_Watermark_CSV
activities.description: Edge case #1: Detects misconfigured incremental jobs where Watermark_Column or Watermark_Value is NULL. Raises a Fail activity (WM001) so the issue is surfaced immediately rather than silently skipped or treated as a full load.

ifTrueActivities.name: Fail_Invalid_Watermark_CSV
ifTrueActivities.description: Raised when an incremental job has no Watermark assigned. Fix: set a valid Watermark_ID in EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef for this job.

message.value: @concat('Incremental job [', item().Metadata_Job, '] (Metadata_ID: ', string(item().Metadata_ID), ') is missing a valid Watermark. Watermark_Column and Watermark_Value must both be set in EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef.')

ifFalseActivities.name: Copy_ASQL_to_ADLS_CSV
ifFalseActivities.description: Copies the incremental delta from Azure SQL to ADLS Gen2 as CSV. Source query is the user-defined base query wrapped in a subquery with the watermark filter applied. Watermark column and last high-water mark value are resolved from EDP_Metadata at runtime.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT * FROM (', json(item().MetadataSettingsInput).Query, ') AS _incremental_src WHERE ', item().Watermark_Column, ' > ''', formatDateTime(item().Watermark_Value, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), '''')

ifFalseActivities.name: Check_Rows_Copied_CSV
ifFalseActivities.description: Edge case #2: Skips the watermark update when 0 rows were copied (no new data since last run). Preserving the existing watermark ensures the same window is re-checked next run rather than silently advancing past potentially missed records.

ifTrueActivities.name: Update_Watermark_CSV
ifTrueActivities.description: Advances Watermark_Value to the current UTC time. Only runs after a confirmed successful copy with at least one row transferred (edge cases #3 and #4). Uses Metadata_ID to identify the correct Watermark row via MetadataRef FK.

text.value: @concat('UPDATE w SET w.Watermark_Value = CONVERT(DATETIME, ''', formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ''') FROM EDP_Metadata.Watermark w JOIN EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef m ON m.Watermark_ID = w.Watermark_ID WHERE m.Metadata_ID = ', string(item().Metadata_ID))

activities.name: Validate_Watermark_PARQUET
activities.description: Edge case #1: Detects missing Watermark on incremental jobs before attempting the copy.

message.value: @concat('Incremental job [', item().Metadata_Job, '] (Metadata_ID: ', string(item().Metadata_ID), ') is missing a valid Watermark. Watermark_Column and Watermark_Value must both be set in EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef.')

ifFalseActivities.name: Copy_ASQL_to_ADLS_PARQUET
ifFalseActivities.description: Copies the incremental delta from Azure SQL to ADLS Gen2 as Parquet. Watermark filter applied as subquery wrapper over the user-defined base query.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT * FROM (', json(item().MetadataSettingsInput).Query, ') AS _incremental_src WHERE ', item().Watermark_Column, ' > ''', formatDateTime(item().Watermark_Value, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), '''')

ifFalseActivities.name: Check_Rows_Copied_PARQUET
ifFalseActivities.description: Edge case #2: Skips watermark update when 0 rows copied.

ifTrueActivities.name: Update_Watermark_PARQUET
ifTrueActivities.description: Advances Watermark_Value to current UTC time after confirmed successful copy with rows transferred.

text.value: @concat('UPDATE w SET w.Watermark_Value = CONVERT(DATETIME, ''', formatDateTime(utcNow(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'), ''') FROM EDP_Metadata.Watermark w JOIN EDP_Metadata.MetadataRef m ON m.Watermark_ID = w.Watermark_ID WHERE m.Metadata_ID = ', string(item().Metadata_ID))
